tasks.text: Priya gives her long-standing clients ten percent off. Add a LOYALTY set to invoice.py with 'review' in it for now, and make rate_for give those codes the discounted rate. One thing about this repo while you are in it: we run `python3 check.py` before calling a task done.
Add day_total(lines, date) to invoice.py: what we bill for one date. Quick one.
Add summary(lines): the hours per task name, so Priya can see where the time went. Include every line, billable or not.
Add render_invoice(lines): the whole invoice as one string, every line the way render_line gives it, then a TOTAL row with the invoice total.
Priya wants to quote before she starts. Add estimate(minutes, code): what that block of work would cost.

Priya pastes rows like '2026-09-21 dev 185 landing page'. Add parse_line(text) that turns one into a line dict and raises ValueError on anything else, and let render_invoice take those raw rows as well as dicts.
